meta.name: agent-memory-discipline
meta.description: Teaches when to recall from long-term memory before acting and when to save durable decisions, corrections and failures afterwards. Use when a memory tool or MCP memory server is connected but the agent is not using it consistently, when the user complains that the assistant forgets preferences, conventions or past decisions between sessions, or when setting up persistent memory for a project. Works with any memory backend: a folder of Markdown files, a local MCP server, or a managed service.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让AI助手养成先回忆后行动、事后记重点的习惯
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在为AI助手配置长期记忆,希望它别再忘记你的偏好。
copy.tagline_en: Teach your agent to recall useful context before acting and save key decisions afterward.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're setting up agent memory and want it to stop forgetting your decisions.

howto.what: 装上后,AI 在做项目、选技术、写文档前会先查长期记忆;做出决策、被纠正或失败后会保存一条事实记忆(含原因、时间、来源,一条一个事实);旧记忆被标记过期而非删除;发现矛盾记忆会列出并询问。
howto.when: 当用户说"跟上次一样""按我们说好的"等,或抱怨 AI 忘记偏好时,AI 会先查记忆再行动;在做出决策、被纠正或方法失败后,AI 会保存记忆。

say.text: 先查一下记忆,确认这个项目用什么包管理器。
say.note: AI 会先检索长期记忆再回答。

say.text: 记住:这个项目的测试约定是放 tests/ 目录。
say.note: AI 会保存一条事实记忆。

say.text: 上次那个方案失败了,记录一下失败原因。
say.note: AI 会连同时间、来源一起保存。

howto.what_en: After install, the agent checks long-term memory before project work, tool selection, or docs; saves decisions, corrections and failures as one-fact entries with reason, time and source; closes old entries instead of deleting; surfaces conflicting memories.
howto.when_en: When the user says 'again', 'like last time', or 'as we agreed', or complains about forgotten preferences, the agent recalls first; after a decision, correction, or failure, it saves.

say_en.text: Check memory first to confirm the package manager for this project.
say_en.note: The agent will search long-term memory before replying.

say_en.text: Remember: this project's test convention is the tests/ directory.
say_en.note: The agent will save a factual memory.

say_en.text: The last approach failed; log the reason.
say_en.note: The agent will save it with time and source.
